DetectedEcosystem.description: One ecosystem found in a project, with the evidence that identified it.

manifest.description: File that proves the ecosystem, relative to the project root (forward slashes).

notes.description: Human-readable caveats, e.g. why only the exit code is trusted.

packages.description:
Restrict the run to these packages (Rust workspaces, from impact analysis).
Empty means the whole ecosystem.

target.description: Optional target passed to the tool (e.g. a `.sln` for `dotnet test`).

Ecosystem.description: A language/build ecosystem Qualyx knows how to discover and test.

TestTool.description: The native tool Qualyx drives for an ecosystem.

oneOf.description: `cargo test`, results parsed from its text output.
`npm test` whose script is `node --test`, with the JUnit reporter.
`npm test` with an unknown runner: only the exit code is trusted.
`npx playwright test` with the JUnit reporter (browser E2E).
